design.purpose: A low connected rack for one phone, tablet or paperback, held between two raised end stops on a bridged plate.

steps.c: Place the dark red 2×2 brick on the table.
Place the red 2×2 brick six studs to the right.
Press the brown 2×8 plate across both supports.
Press the green 2×2 brick onto the left end.
Press the orange 2×2 brick onto the right end.
